Americans For Medical Rights Launches Great New Web Site: Medmjscience.org

See

From Dave Fratello Of AMR
amr@lainet.com(Dave Fratello)
March 16, 1999

This week we officially launch a new web compilation of scientific and medical information about the medical uses of marijuana. Timed to accompany Wednesday’s release of a new medical marijuana report by the Institute of Medicine, this new website offers individual studies, historical reviews, and informed opinion.

All of this information is presented in an easily viewed, easily printed format.

Check it out at: http://medmjscience.org

Americans for Medical Rights owes maximum thanks to Tim Killian and Eventure Communications in Seattle for the weeks’ worth of dedicated work in creating this new resource.
